profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Micro Key Solutions, Inc
profile.summary:
-  Database specialist with excellent working knowledge of Client/Server applications. 
-  Proven track record in team development environment. 
-  SQL Specialist.  
-  Write programs as assigned by coding, debugging, testing and documenting according to industry
    standards.  
-  Document program logic, user instructions, and operating procedures.  
-  Research and determine causes of program malfunctions and re-code as needed.  
-  Design and create program input/output specifications, report layouts and logic flow diagrams.  
-  Participate in the planning, scheduling and the coordination of activities required developing and 
   implementing software applications.  
-  Evaluate new technology and concepts and their application for possible implementation into software   
    applications

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Hired to help upgrade company’s complete Clipper for DOS product line to Windows environment, producing all new, fully integrated, accounting and real-time, mission critical 24x7 signal-processing applications. 

Responsible for programming Automated Clearing House (ACH) module for software package Accounting Module.
 
Responsible for architecture, design, and programming of Service Scheduling module which integrates with companies accounting and service tracking application.

Responsible for architecture, design, and programming of Inventory Tracking and Job Costing module which integrated with companies accounting and signal processing application.

Responsible for development of installation scripts for software. 

Developed data import application for use with companies accounting application.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Hired as a consultant to develop a Job Costing and Service Tracking application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Hired to upgrade company's Multiple Employer Trust (MET) Insurance Administration/Claims Adjudication FoxPro for DOS application to 32 bit Windows environment. Responsible for all aspects of architecture, design, programming and development. 

Developed administration and customer service application for the Physician's Mutual Insurance Company (PMIC), a then new line of business which also integrated with legacy systems. Responsible for all aspects of design, programming, and development. 

Re-engineered a mission critical Managed Care Review Services (MCRS) precertification and letter writing system. 

Developed Automated Clearing House (ACH) application to adhere to standard ACH regulations, and interface with legacy systems, which billed premiums for policy holders, created files for upload to bank mainframe for debit of accounts. Responsible for all aspects of design, programming, and development.  


Developed Preferred Provider Organization (PPO) billing application for PMIC line of business. Used Microsoft Visual FoxPro 5. 

Responsible for maintenance of MET and PMIC DOS based legacy systems

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Hired as a junior grade programmer to help modify and enhance company's mission critical FoxPro for DOS Therapy Revenue Tracking System. 

Responsible for writing custom reports for corporate use. 

Responsible for collection of data from 33 remote sites, and integrating polled data into corporate database on a nightly basis
